request.notes: Pilot only: 8 truths are drawn from the public prior inside the job and written to the outputs; never reusable as an exam. The world secret is generated in the job (os.urandom) and never written (commitment only). float64 world, float32 nets. CPU smoke test (--smoke) and check_lib.py passed. Expected about 1.5-2 h on one A100.
request.purpose: Round 4 study sbi: simulate-to-train on the gliders exam world: synthetic-likelihood identification of 4 hidden parameters at 5 Lab budgets (8 fresh pilot truths), predictors trained on real vs simulated data
request.run: python -c 'import jax, numpy, scipy; print(jax.__version__, numpy.__version__, scipy.__version__, jax.devices())' && cd research/alife/vecworld/program/round4/sbi && python -B run_sbi.py --out $OUT --max-hours 2.6
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
